title: 3D DRC: Design Rule Checking for 3D IC with U-Net-based Non-Manhattan Optimization
problem: 3D IC design rule checking must handle both 2D/3D rules and non-Manhattan geometries, but existing tools require sequential workflows increasing complexity.
motivation: Unified 3D DRC enabling single-pass checking improves verification efficiency for advanced packaging technologies.
method: U-Net-based deep learning model performs 2D and 3D DRC simultaneously with optimizations for non-Manhattan geometries. Trained on various PDK rule sets for generalization.
key_novelty: U-Net-based unified 2D/3D DRC tool with non-Manhattan geometry support, replacing sequential tool workflows.
contributions: U-Net architecture for 2D/3D DRC rule checking in single pass
Optimizations for non-Manhattan geometry handling in 3D IC
Generalization across open-source PDK rule sets
22.3x faster than Calibre nmDRC; 13.3x faster than Calibre 3DSTACK
limitations: Deep learning approach may struggle with unseen PDK rules; training data requirements not detailed.
